name: scriptsentry
description: Client-side JavaScript security findings from the ScriptSentry engine, in the Problems panel. Everything runs locally.

scriptsentry.engineCommand.description: Command that runs the engine CLI, e.g. "python3 /path/to/ScriptSentry/main.py". Paths with spaces: use an array ["python3", "/path with spaces/main.py"]. Leave empty to auto-detect (the launcher cache at ~/.scriptsentry/bootstrap, or a ScriptSentry checkout open in the workspace).

scriptsentry.scanOnSave.description: Run a scan of the saved file automatically (JavaScript/TypeScript files).

scriptsentry.showSuppressed.description: Also show findings you marked as false positives in the dashboard (as hints, prefixed [false positive]).

scriptsentry.engineTimeoutSeconds.description: Kill the engine after this many seconds.
